recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source change is needed for FHIR-12201 unless a future work-group decision changes Timing repeat semantics or the days-of-week terminology.
issue_request: FHIR-12201 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 and requested a Timing option to express schedules on specified weekdays such as Monday, Wednesday, and Friday; the approved resolution added Timing.repeat.dayOfWeek as 0..* code with a required DayOfWeek binding.
initial_application: The request was applied in svn revision 10350, represented by git commit 91bf3e7b836dc9486da4c4d4b7829d9df7167900, which added Timing.repeat.dayOfWeek to source/datatypes/timing.xml as part of a grouped Timing commit for FHIR-10478, FHIR-12201, and FHIR-12352.
additional_context: Timing is an active datatype in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-12460 intentionally relaxed the original dayOfWeek/frequency/period prohibition, and related FHIR-25289/FHIR-23710 Timing comment cleanup is already represented on the combined branch. Direct FHIR-12201 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no source edit is needed: the authoritative Timing spreadsheet, terminology source, and narrative example already satisfy the seed after later Timing decisions are considered.
